{
  "candidate_rtl": "module comparator_16bit (
    input [15:0] A,
    input [15:0] B,
    output gt,
    output eq,
    output lt
);
    wire [15:0] same;
    wire [3:0] group_eq;
    wire [3:0] group_gt;
    wire [3:0] group_lt;

    assign same = ~(A ^ B);

    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < 4; k = k + 1) begin : compare_groups
            assign group_eq[k] = &same[4*k +: 4];
            assign group_gt[k] =
                (A[4*k+3] & ~B[4*k+3]) |
                (same[4*k+3] & A[4*k+2] & ~B[4*k+2]) |
                (same[4*k+3] & same[4*k+2] & A[4*k+1] & ~B[4*k+1]) |
                (same[4*k+3] & same[4*k+2] & same[4*k+1] & A[4*k] & ~B[4*k]);
            assign group_lt[k] = ~(group_gt[k] | group_eq[k]);
        end
    endgenerate

    assign eq = &group_eq;
    assign gt = group_gt[3] |
                (group_eq[3] & group_gt[2]) |
                (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_gt[1]) |
                (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_eq[1] & group_gt[0]);
    assign lt = group_lt[3] |
                (group_eq[3] & group_lt[2]) |
                (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_lt[1]) |
                (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_eq[1] & group_lt[0]);
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "Wide magnitude comparisons can create long significance-resolution paths. Independently expressed greater-than, less-than, and equality operations also leave their sharing and decomposition to synthesis.",
  "rewrite": "Use four parallel four-bit comparisons with shared bit-equality signals, followed by explicit four-group lookahead. Derive less-than within each four-bit group from the complement of greater-than or equality, avoiding a second complete local magnitude network. Both final magnitude outputs use parallel group lookahead.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The explicit two-tier structure is intended to shorten significance propagation and expose compact complex-gate mapping opportunities. Actual timing improvement and electrical-limit compliance require the specified mapping and STA flow; no measured gain is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Shared equality and locally derived less-than limit duplication, while the expanded lookahead introduces multi-input product terms. Mapped area and compliance with the 547.775360 um2 cap remain to be measured.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the original module name and unsigned 16-bit input and scalar output ports. For every binary input pair, equality is exact and the highest unequal bit determines both magnitude outputs. Local less-than complementation is valid for all binary four-bit operands. The design is purely combinational and has no parameters, state, assumptions, or external dependencies."
}
